content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DCPU Chengalpattu Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DCPU Chengalpattu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for DCPU Chengalpattu Recruitment 2026 is 22 September 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach the specified address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in DCPU Chengalpattu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for various posts including Assistant Cum Bench Clerk, Junior Assistant Cum Record Clerk, and Office Assistant under DCPU Chengalpattu Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for DCPU Chengalpattu jobs?
faq.answer: The application mode for DCPU Chengalpattu Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it by post along with the required documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for Assistant Cum Bench Clerk post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Assistant Cum Bench Clerk post is Rs. 25,000 per month. Salaries for other posts vary, ranging from Rs. 13,000 to Rs. 20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the minimum educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualifications vary by post. For Assistant Cum Bench Clerk, a Bachelor's Degree is required. For Junior Assistant, SSLC (Class 10) is needed, and for Office Assistant, Class 8 pass is sufficient.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for DCPU Chengalpattu Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for DCPU Chengalpattu Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply free of cost.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts under DCPU Chengalpattu Recruitment 2026 is 42 years. There are no specific minimum age limits mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for DCPU Chengalpattu posts?
faq.answer: The job location for these contractual positions is Chengalpattu, Tamil Nadu. Candidates selected will be posted within the District Child Protection Unit, Chengalpattu.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for DCPU Chengalpattu?
faq.answer: The official website for District Child Protection Unit Chengalpattu is http://chengalpattu.nic.in. Candidates can visit this site to download the application form and access other relevant information.
